problem_statement: m-i-n-a-r/sparky-portfolio (Sparky) is a static single-page developer portfolio (HTML5 UP style particle header, bio, skills lists, a Projects/'MY WORKS' section, fun facts, statistics, and a contact footer) served straight from index.html with assets/css/main.css. The 'MY WORKS' section lists five real spotlight project cards, each labelled with a lane (Design lane / Build lane / Collaboration lane). Deliver three coordinated things while preserving the Sparky visual system: (1) Give the 'MY WORKS' grid a native lane filter: a row of filter buttons (All lanes / Design lane / Build lane / Collaboration lane) above the grid, plus a '#lane-readout' count. The filter tab row must stay within the viewport on a 390px phone with NO horizontal document overflow (a fixed non-wrapping row pushes the whole page sideways); the tab buttons must wrap/shrink cleanly — do not merely clip with overflow-x:hidden, the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width. (2) Wire the filter end to end: clicking a lane button must actually show/hide the real project cards whose lane matches AND update the '#lane-readout' to 'Showing N of 5 · <selected lane>' (e.g. clicking Design lane filters to the two design cards and sets 'Showing 2 of 5 · Design lane') in addition to highlighting the active button — the post-click terminal state must reflect the filtered set, not the default 'Showing 5 of 5 · All lanes'. (3) Promote the lane taxonomy into a shared 'Portfolio lanes' status strip that appears consistently in the projects section, the fun-facts section AND the footer, styled to match the quiet ivory/green Sparky editorial language (light surface, restrained green border, 8px radius, green lane chips) — the rendered grid and strip must be visually faithful to the reference, with cleanly stacked legible project cards, not a collapsed or off-palette pile. Keep the particle header, bio, skills lists, the five spotlight project cards with their Learn More buttons, fun facts, statistics, footer, scripts, and desktop/tablet layout intact.
required_content: The 'MY WORKS' grid gains a lane filter tab row (All lanes / Design lane / Build lane / Collaboration lane) plus a '#lane-readout' count; the tab row renders within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px (it wraps/shrinks, it is not merely clipped with overflow-x:hidden).

The lane filter is wired end to end: clicking a lane button filters the real spotlight project cards to that lane AND updates the '#lane-readout' to 'Showing N of 5 · <selected lane>' (e.g. clicking Design lane sets 'Showing 2 of 5 · Design lane'); the post-click terminal state reflects the filtered set, not the default 'Showing 5 of 5 · All lanes'.

A shared 'Portfolio lanes' status strip (Design lane / Build lane / Collaboration lane) appears consistently in the projects section, the fun-facts section AND the footer — the same lane component in all three places, not only in the projects section.

The 'MY WORKS' grid, its lane filter and the 'Portfolio lanes' strip keep the Sparky editorial look (ivory/green palette, restrained borders, 8px radius, green lane chips) and are visually faithful to the reference rendering — cleanly stacked, legible project cards, not a collapsed, overlapping or off-palette pile.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports.

The particle header, bio, skills lists, the five spotlight project cards with their Learn More buttons, fun facts, the statistics block, and the contact footer remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font errors).
design_constraints: Add the lane filter tab row + count above the existing 'MY WORKS' grid and make its tab row responsive; do not delete the project cards, change their copy, or restyle unrelated sections.
Add the SAME shared 'Portfolio lanes' status strip component to the projects, fun-facts and footer sections so the lane language is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one section.

Preserve the Sparky design language: dark particle background, white main panel, green accent, rounded 8px cards, uppercase section headings, existing spotlight rhythm; the grid and strip must render in the ivory/green editorial palette with legible, cleanly separated project cards.
Keep the lane filter interaction wired end to end (clicking a lane must filter the real cards and the #lane-readout count must reflect the clicked lane), not merely a class toggle.
Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static build with a clean console.
state_constraints: desktop_initial / tablet_initial / mobile_initial capture the top of the single-page portfolio (particle header, bio) at 1440px, 834px, and 390px.
desktop_project_atlas and mobile_project_atlas scroll the Project Atlas card into view; the buggy build shows the fixed-width metric strip pushing the page sideways on mobile.
desktop_project_cards and desktop_late_projects scroll through the spotlight project rhythm.
desktop_infos_regression, desktop_footer_regression, and mobile_footer_regression scroll the statistics and contact footer into view to confirm the rest of the page is unaffected.
Source inspection confirms the site is a static index.html + assets/css/main.css portfolio with no build step; the mobile overflow originates solely in the `.project-atlas-strip` layout rules.

change_completion: The 'MY WORKS' grid gains a responsive lane filter tab row that fits the mobile viewport.
Clicking a lane filters the real project cards and updates the #lane-readout count ('Showing N of 5 · <lane>').
The shared 'Portfolio lanes' status strip appears in the projects, fun-facts and footer sections.
design_consistency: The Sparky palette, card chrome, accent color, and spotlight rhythm are preserved.
The works grid, lane filter and 'Portfolio lanes' strip keep the ivory/green editorial look with legible, cleanly stacked cards and are visually faithful to the reference.
interaction_continuity: Clicking a lane filter button filters the real cards and updates the 'Showing N of 5 · <lane>' count (post-click terminal state reflects the change, not the default).
regression: Particle header, bio, skills, spotlight projects, fun facts, statistics, and footer remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from index.html with a clean browser console.
responsive: 390px homepage (initial, works filter, footer) and 834px tablet have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The lane filter tab buttons wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static-portfolio Repair/regression_continuity task hardened to L4 with a NATIVE lever: the portfolio's own 'MY WORKS' project grid gains a lane filter that actually filters the five real spotlight project cards (images pipboy.png / Birday.png etc.) with a live count. The reference (a) makes the lane filter tab row responsive (wrapping flex 1 1 auto -> 0 mobile overflow), (b) wires the filter so clicking a lane shows/hides the matching project cards and updates the #lane-readout to 'Showing N of 5 · <lane>', and (c) promotes a shared 'Portfolio lanes' status strip into the projects, fun-facts and footer sections in the ivory/green Sparky palette. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution keeps the tab row a narrow fixed 620px nowrap row + overflow-x:hidden (still overflows -> D6 fail), collapses the works grid so the project cards shingle/overlap via negative margins into an illegible dark-on-dark pile (D3 visual_regression fail on the grid geometry), adds the status strip to the projects section only (D2 cross-section fail on fun-facts + footer), and freezes the filter count at a snapshot so the click toggles .active but never re-filters or re-counts (click succeeds but the readout stays 'Showing 5 of 5 · All lanes' -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. FontAwesome is vendored locally (assets/css/icons.css) as declared INFRA identical across all legs; the graded files are index.html, assets/css/main.css and the assets/js/works-filter.js image gallery filter script.
